Of all the tickets printed for "EMERALD MINE 9X", only a small slice are still unsold. The game is close to selling out, with one of ten top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

The table below shows the full count for "EMERALD MINE 9X", with every prize level included.
5055.headline: Early stage or late

5057.body:
"EASY MONEY" has three of eight top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About three-quarters of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

If you play "EASY MONEY" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
5057.headline: Early stage or late

5059.body:
The prize money on "THE CASH WHEEL" leans toward many smaller prizes. It is spread over fourteen prize levels, from wins equal to the ticket price up to $1 million. Games built like this pay out often, in small amounts. That design never changes, and it is the part you choose.

The table below shows the full count for "THE CASH WHEEL", with every prize level included.
5059.headline: Where the prize money is

5060.body:
Most of the tickets for "FIND THE 7S" have been sold. The game is near the end of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed faster than the tickets are selling, which is a reason to be careful.

Everything above about "FIND THE 7S" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
5060.headline: Early stage or late

5063.body:
About a third of the tickets for "CA$H IN HAND" have been sold. The game is in the middle of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a smaller share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a reason to be careful.

The numbers for "CA$H IN HAND" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
